title: After 15 Years, Surprise Action Series Confirms Return With New Anime Revival
content:
A classic action series has surprisingly announced it’s coming back with a new anime revival to help celebrate its 15th anniversary. If you are of a certain age, you might have noticed how there have been many classic anime and manga franchises coming back with new anime adaptations . Revivals and reboots have led to a lot of nostalgic successes in the last few years, and that’s opened the doors to all sorts of new releases for fans to keep an eye out for. That’s the case for Aria the Scarlet Ammo too.

The anime adaptation for Chugaku Akamatsu and Kobuichi’s Aria the Scarlet Ammo light novel series is now celebrating the 15th anniversary of its original anime debut , and Kadokawa has confirmed that the franchise is going all out for the occasion. Aria the Scarlet Ammo is returning with a new anime short scheduled to make its debut next year, and has revealed the first look at some of the new and returning faces fans will see in action with the revival.

New Aria the Scarlet Ammo Anime Short Announced for 15th Anniversary

Officially titled Aria the Scarlet Ammo Corto , the new revival anime short is currently scheduled for a release next year. No concrete release date or potential international release plans have been announced as of this time, but it’s going to feature familiar faces behind the scenes. Original series writer Chugaku Akamatsu is overseeing the script together with the Kenji Saito with Yoshifumi Sasahara is directing the new revival at BELLNOX FILMS. It’s not a familiar production staff from the original series, but it will sound familiar.

Returning voice cast members announced to return for Aria the Scarlet Ammo Corto include the likes of Rie Kugimiya as Aria H. Kanzaki, Junji Majima as Kinji Toyama, Mikako Takahashi as Shirayuki Hotogi, Mariya Ise as Riko Mine, Kaori Ishihara as Reki, and Ayako Kawasumi as Jeanne d’Arc. New additions to the cast making their debut in this new revival short include Emiri Iwai as Lisa Ave du Ank, Miyari Nemoto as Minuet Holmes, and Anzu Haruno as Nemo Rinkarun. They can be seen in action with this first look poster you find above.

What Is Aria the Scarlet Ammo ?

Aria the Scarlet Ammo likely isn’t the first action series you think of when imagining all of the potential revivals and reboots that could be coming down the pipeline next, but it’s likely one of those 2010s anime gems that just shook loose in your memory. The series is set in a school where students are trained in a deadly martial art known as Butei that teaches them how to use various weapons and other assassin skills. When Toyama is attacked by an assassin setting out to kill Butei fighters, he’s soon saved by the prodigy Aria.

Aria the Scarlet Ammo technically ran for two seasons, but the second season was more of a spinoff story about a different character connected to Aria. So this is the first proper continuation of the anime since that first season came to an end in 2011. It’s a return from the 2010s wave of franchises , and we’re likely to get much more. How do you feel about Aria the Scarlet Ammo making its comeback? Let us know your thoughts in the comments.

title: Netflix’s One Piece Season 3 Readies for Launch With New Behind-the-Scenes Teases
content:
One Piece ‘s live-action series is fast approaching its return to Netflix next year, and it’s one step closer to that launch with the start of a new wave of behind-the-scenes videos showing off more of the series’ production. One Piece has been an incredible success for Netflix ever since the live-action series first made its debut . Quickly renewed for not just one, but two new seasons, the team behind it all has been hard at work on adapting Eiichiro Oda’s massive manga series for the past few years.

One Piece: The Battle of Alabasta is the third major season of the live-action series as it sees Luffy and the Straw Hats heading into Alabasta in order to save Princess Vivi’s kingdom , but it has yet to confirm a proper release date as of this time. But now that seems closer than ever before as One Piece will begin to release a series of special behind the scenes videos to give fans a better look at how Season 2 all came together. It’s time to get hyped.

When Does One Piece Season 3 Come Out on Netflix?

One Piece: The Battle of Alabasta is currently scheduled for a release with Netflix sometime in 2027 , but has yet to nail down a more concrete release date or window as of this time. This new wave of behind the scenes videos for the second season kick off a new project that will likely lead to the reveal of when this third season is finally coming our way. With promotional materials for the franchise heating up once more, it’s time to start looking ahead to what could be coming our way in this new season.

One Piece: The Battle of Alabasta will be expanding its roles for some of the major players who debuted in the second season such as Mikaela Hoover as Tony Tony Chopper, Charithra Chandran as Princess Vivi, Sendhil Ramamurthy as Nefartari Cobra, Lera Abova as Nico Robin, and Joe Manganiello as Sir Crocodile ( who has been steadily teasing his return for the past few months as well ). Serving as the Straw Hats’ first major battle on the Grand Line, this could be a major turning point for the franchise.

What’s New for One Piece Season 3 on Netflix?

One Piece: The Battle of Alabasta will also be introducing many new faces to the expanding cast with the introduction of this new region too such as Xolo Maridueña as Ace , Cole Escola as Bon Clay, Awdo Awdo as Mr. 1, Daisy Head as Miss Doublefinger, Emilio Sakraya as Koza, Omid Abtahi as Toto, Jamie Ward as Pell, and Nabeel Khan as Chaka revealed thus far. But there will likely be many other new faces revealed the closer we get to Season 3’s big debut in the coming months.

With the franchise revealing more behind the scenes information for the second season, it’s going to give fans the best look yet at how production has been thinking in their approach to it all. This is going to be very important heading into the third season as the future of the live-action series remains uncertain , but we’ll have to see how it shakes out soon enough. But what do you want to see from One Piece ‘s live-action series next? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Major Shonen Jump Series Officially Ends After 6 Years With Final Release
content:
Another major series has ended its run in the pages of Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine after six years of serialization with the release of its final chapter, and it makes the 14th title coming to an end this year overall. It’s the final transitional phase for Shonen Jump for the year as a final batch of series are coming to their ends, and a few new titles are kicking off their own runs. And following the end of Kenta Shinohara’s Witch Watch last week , Yuto Suzuki’s Sakamoto Days has now come to an end.

Yuto Suzuki’s Sakamoto Days has now officially come to an end with Shonen Jump with the release of Chapter 284, six years after it originally made its debut. The series has been in the midst of its final arc for the past year, so fans have been preparing to say goodbye to the series for quite some time. But with many more fans assuming it would end earlier this Summer, the story was able to take its time and reach a more conclusive finale than many other Shonen Jump titles get .

Sakamoto Days Ends in Shonen Jump After 6 Years With Chapter 284

Sakamoto Days comes to an end with the release of Chapter 284 , and the series puts a final stamp on Taro Sakamoto’s journey overall. Following the final fight with X, the penultimate chapter of the series moved time ahead a year or so to the birth of the Sakamoto family’s next child. With the JAA being dismantled and assassins no longer being needed, Sakamoto starts a whole new group to take its place that uses non-lethal tactics for its takedowns instead in order to keep the power balance.

Sakamoto’s dream of turning his convenience store into a franchise has also worked with a chain of stores across the region, and the final chapter reveals how each of the survivors (both friends and former foes) have since gone on to live new lives that don’t focus on killing. It’s a bright future for everyone as the world finds a new era of peace after everything that’s happened, and it’s clear that Sakamoto has indeed had an impact on everyone he’s come across through his time as a deadly killer.

What’s Next for Shonen Jump ?

Though Sakamoto Days has now come to an end, thankfully it’s far from the end of the franchise on a whole. The anime is set to return to screens with Season 2 in January , and it’s already looking to keep up the hot streak. As for Shonen Jump , this is the 14th major title to come to an end this year but only the sixth series to end under its own terms without being cancelled. The number of titles that have ended in 2026 break down as such:

• Otr of the Flame

• Harukaze Mound

• Gonron Egg

• The Mage Next Door

• Hero Girl and Demon Lord Call It Quits

• Alien Headbutt

• Kinato’s Magic

• Drawn to the Fire

• Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo

• Hima-ten!

• Blue Box

• The Elusive Samurai

• Witch Watch

• Sakamoto Days

With one new series still scheduled to make its debut next week following the return of two major creators that have started off their own new works , it likely means there will be one more series ended before 2026 comes to an end. But how are you feeling about Sakamoto Days coming to an end? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: 'Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen' Creator Launches New Manga
content:
The 52nd issue of Weekly Shounen Jump magazine began serializing a new manga by Hitsuji Gondaira , titled Ginza Uradoori Kouban no Hizuki-san ( Hizuki of the Ginza Patrol ), on Monday. This marks Gondaira's return to serialization in nearly two years following the end of Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen in January 2025.

Gondaira is best known for Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen ( Mission: Yozakura Family ), which ran in Weekly Shounen Magazine from August 2019 to January 2025. Shueisha published the 29th and final volume in March 2025. The manga has a cumulative 3.6 million copies of its volumes in circulation.

VIZ Media and Shueisha simulpublish the Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen manga in English on its Manga Plus app and website. The former also publishes the manga in physical format and released the 25th volume on October 20. The 26th volume is planned for a December 15 release.

VIZ Media simulpub the Hizuki of the Ginza Patrol manga in English through its Shonen Jump service.

SILVER LINK. adapted the manga into a 27-episode television anime , which aired from Spring to Fall 2024. Hulu and Disney+ streamed the anime with subtitles and an English dub. A second season premiered in Spring 2026, followed by its second cour on October 11.

Gondaira received an honorable mention at the 43rd JUMP Treasure Newcomer Manga Award for his work IBIS. He also won the Grand Prix at the 10th Golden Future Cup in 2015 for his one-shot manga Genjuui Totek.

Synopsis Set in Meiji-era Japan, the story follows a police officer stationed at a police box in a backstreet of Ginza, during a period of significant cultural change.

title: Manga 'Sakamoto Days' Concludes Serialization
content:
Yuuto Suzuki 's Sakamoto Days manga has concluded with chapter 284 in the 52nd issue of Weekly Shounen Jump magazine on Monday, after 6-year serialization.

Suzuki originally drew the action comedy manga as a one-shot in Jump GIGA magazine in December 2019. The manga began serializing in the Weekly Shounen Jump in November 2020. Shueisha published the 29th volume on November 4. The manga has over 18 million copies in circulation.

Produced by TMS Entertainment , the first season aired in split cours in Winter 2025 and Summer 2025 . A second season is scheduled to premiere in January 2027.

Viz Media licensed the manga for English release in July 2021 and published the 23rd volume on September 15, with the 24th volume scheduled for December 15. Shueisha began simulpublishing the manga in English on its Manga plus website in November 2020.

Synopsis Tarou Sakamoto was considered the greatest hitman of all time. Feared by many, he stood at the top of the underground world until he met and fell in love with a woman. As a result, Sakamoto abandoned his life of crime and now works as a convenience store clerk.

Leaving his shady past behind proves more difficult than Sakamoto initially imagined. Many of his former rivals and partners do not believe that he has truly left the business and show up in hopes of taking him out. Barred from killing, Sakamoto must find creative ways to subdue his enemies and prevent them from bringing harm to his family, his store, and the small town he resides in. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

Official manga site: https://www.shonenjump.com/j/rensai/sakamoto.html

title: Witch on the Holy Night Film Expands 981 Cuts for ScreenX Release
content:
The official website for the Witch on the Holy Night ( Mahōtsukai no Yoru ) anime film announced on Sunday that the film will begin playing in the premium formats ScreenX, Ultra 4DX, Dolby Cinema, 4DX, and MX4D in Japan this Friday, November 27. In particular, the anime studio ufotable produced about 981 updated cuts for the footage projected onto the two side screens for the Screen X release. According to the film's ScreenX trailer below, that amounts to 67 minutes and six seconds of the film's 129-minute runtime:

The ScreenX format enhances a film by projecting onto two additional screens on the walls to the left and right of the main screen.

The story of the original Witch on the Holy Night visual novel is set in the late 1980s, and centers on protagonist Aoko Aozaki, one of two sister heirs to a long family line of modern mages. Although she is disinterested in magic, she is suddenly declared as the heir of their family's magical art, and reluctantly begins her apprenticeship under Alice Kuonji, a young witch who lives in a lonely manor atop a hill. Aoko balances her duties of learning the arcane, while also serving as her school's student council president. She also makes the acquaintance of Sōjūrō Shizuki (romanized as Soujyuro Sizuki in the English version of the game), a new transfer student who is unfamiliar with much of the modern world, and contends with the plots of her older sister Tōko Aozaki, who feels that her birthright has been denied.

The film features a returning cast:

• Haruka Tomatsu as Aoko Aozaki

• Kana Hanazawa as Alice Kuonji

• Yūsuke Kobayashi as Soujyuro Sizuki

The staff members are:

• Director: Masashi Takeuchi

• Character Design: Moe Tsuzuki

• Chief Animation Director: Masato Nagamori

• Script Production: ufotable

• Sub-Character Design: Nana Ishigo, Masato Nagamori

• Prop Design: Masato Saitō

• Compositing Director of Photography/Finishing Technical Director: Yuichi Terao

• 3D Director: Gōchū Satō

• Art Director: Koji Eto

• Color Key Artist: Mika Matsuoka

• Editing: Manabu Kamino

• Music: Hideyuki Fukasawa

• Chief Director: Hikaru Kondo

The film opened on regular and IMAX screens in Japan on November 20. The original visual novel game's smartphone version launched on the same day as the film's opening in Japan.

Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment will screen the film in the U.S. and Canada on January 29, 2027. The film will screen in Japanese with English subtitles and with an English dub .

Type-Moon most recently released the game on Steam in December 2023.

Aniplex released the PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch versions of the game in the West in December 2022, on the same day as the game's Japanese release date. The PS4 and Switch versions have sold more than 150,000 copies worldwide.

Mahōtsukai no Yoru was one of the first collaborations between Kinoko Nasu and artist Takashi Takeuchi in the mid-90s, preceding their founding of Type-Moon . Initially a novel, Nasu and Takeuchi only showed the draft to friends and did not officially release it. Type-Moon eventually developed it into a visual novel with graphics by Hirokazu Koyama that shipped in April 2012, with two sequels planned.

The story is noted for being one of the few tangible connections in the loosely connected "Nasuverse," the English-speaking fan term for the shared universe and cosmology in Type-Moon 's works, including Tsukihime , Fate/stay night , and The Garden of Sinners . An older Aoko Aozaki is an early mentor to Tsukihime protagonist Shiki Tohno, while an older Tōko Aozaki is an employer to Garden of Sinners protagonist Shiki Ryōgi. Tsukihime -A piece of blue glass moon-, the remake of Type-Moon 's Tsukihime dōjin visual novel game, launched in Japan for PS4 and Switch in August 2021. The game launched on PS4 and Switch in English in June 2024.

Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment will screen the film in the U.S. and Canada on January 29, 2027. The film will screen in Japanese with English subtitles and with an English dub .
Type-Moon most recently released the game on Steam in December 2023.

Aniplex released the PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch versions of the game in the West in December 2022, on the same day as the game's Japanese release date. The PS4 and Switch versions have sold more than 150,000 copies worldwide.

Mahōtsukai no Yoru was one of the first collaborations between Kinoko Nasu and artist Takashi Takeuchi in the mid-90s, preceding their founding of Type-Moon . Initially a novel, Nasu and Takeuchi only showed the draft to friends and did not officially release it. Type-Moon eventually developed it into a visual novel with graphics by Hirokazu Koyama that shipped in April 2012, with two sequels planned.

The story is noted for being one of the few tangible connections in the loosely connected "Nasuverse," the English-speaking fan term for the shared universe and cosmology in Type-Moon 's works, including Tsukihime , Fate/stay night , and The Garden of Sinners . An older Aoko Aozaki is an early mentor to Tsukihime protagonist Shiki Tohno, while an older Tōko Aozaki is an employer to Garden of Sinners protagonist Shiki Ryōgi. Tsukihime -A piece of blue glass moon-, the remake of Type-Moon 's Tsukihime dōjin visual novel game, launched in Japan for PS4 and Switch in August 2021. The game launched on PS4 and Switch in English in June 2024.

title: Crunchyroll’s Darkest Fall 2026 Anime Has Become the Perfect Zombie Anime
content:
Crunchyroll ‘s darkest anime of Fall 2026 has become a zombie anime with the ideal setup, complementing the series’ premise and making it even spookier and scarier. The zombie genre is famous across all forms of media, regardless of how it is presented. Many popular zombie anime have incorporated the genre as a comedic element. While they still feature spooky and scary elements, what the darkest anime of Fall 2026 is doing is arguably among the scariest portrayals yet. The Vermilion Mask emerged as a spooky anime thanks to its intriguing premise, in which a mask’s type determines the powers of its wearer.

The series has deliberately portrayed the masks’ powers as dark and unsettling, establishing the anime’s overall tone. Now, in the latest episode, The Vermilion Mask Episode 7, the series has introduced a mask user with arguably one of the most terrifying powers, elevating its horror elements even further. It introduces the Mask of Necromancy, which allows its user to control the dead, as its name suggests. However, the new villain is not simply another mask user but also has a devastating plan, unleashing an apocalyptic zombie outbreak that transforms The Vermilion Mask into a zombie survival action thriller with horror elements .

Crunchyroll’s The Vermilion Mask Has the Perfect Setup to Become a Zombie Anime

The Vermilion Mask Episode 7, titled “The Mask of Necromancy,” introduces a new character named Rinne, who strangely first appears in Peru’s dream before being revealed as the leader of the cult that worships the legendary mask maker Gaston. However, the episode later delivers a surprising revelation: Rinne is the user of the Mask of Necromancy, which is unveiled alongside two more striking details. The first is that this mask has a threat level of four, the same as the Mask of the Warrior God. While this alone is enough to shake Peru and his allies’ confidence in how they would deal with it, the second detail reveals that Rinne is the master of this mask.

This means that Rinne and the mask share the same thoughts and desires, with both seeking the same goal: the destruction of humanity. It is now evident that, through the Mask of Necromancy, Rinne plans to gain control over the dead, with the mask also possessing the strange ability to manipulate living humans, as seen with Akane, a woman somehow connected to Peru’s childhood. The setup for a horror scenario goes beyond what the series’ previous arcs have presented, and with several other elements in play, this new arc has the potential to become the perfect zombie anime .

While the dead coming back to life and attempting to recruit others into their cult is one of the fun elements that gives the series a zombie-like presence, the introduction of Mok Sharib adds another layer. Despite possessing a spooky mask ability that makes him seem like a ghost, he is comically afraid of zombies and ghosts, adding a much-needed element of humor to the series. All in all, The Vermilion Mask has been doing exceptionally well with each arc, and the newest one introduces a zombie premise that perfectly complements the series’ overall vibe. Crunchyroll’s darkest anime of Fall 2026 has transformed into something incredibly versatile , making it a series that everyone should definitely be watching.

title: Nahato's 'The One. Later On...' Light Novels Get TV Anime in 2027
content:
A website opened on Sunday to announce the television anime adaptation of Nahato 's Sono Mono. Nochi ni... ( The One. Later On... ) light novel series which will premiere in 2027. The website also presented a teaser visual and the anime's main cast and staff members.

The anime will star:

Kent Itō as Wazu

Yui Ogura as Mear

Kōichi Ōhata ( Burst Angel , Ikki Tousen: Dragon Destiny director) is the anime's chief director, and Seung Deok Kim ( Black Clover , Lucifer and the Biscuit Hammer , Ace of Diamond Act II episode director) is directing the anime at Jumondo . Ōhata is also overseeing the series scripts along with Hisashi Morimiya ( Queen's Blade: Rebellion , The Warrior Princess and the Barbaric King ), and designing the characters with Choi Yeon-soo (name romanization not confirmed). Pony Canyon is in charge of music production. Kent Itō will also perform the anime's opening theme song.

Titan Manga is releasing Shinichirō Nariie 's manga adaptation of the novel under the title The One. Later On... , and describes the story:

Wazu's life was forever changed when he was rejected by the hero's party and forced to leave his hometown. Once a weak, ordinary boy, he spent two years training alone in the mountains to prove his worth. Now, stronger and determined, Wazu returns to a world that has moved on — only to find his childhood friend, Aria, engaged to the hero who once mocked him. Heartbroken, Wazu embarks on a new journey, facing misunderstandings, new relationships, and the challenge of finding his place in a world that has changed.

Nahato launched the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in September 2015, and ended it in August 2016. Earth Star Entertainment released the novel series with illustrations by Kazutomo Miya in 12 main volumes and one spinoff volume in print. The manga adaptation launched in August 2018, and Earth Star Entertainment published the sixth volume in November 2022.

title: Singer, Voice Actress Kiyono Yasuno Announces Marriage
content:
Voice actress Kiyono Yasuno announced her marriage on her official website on Sunday.

In her written message, Yasuno expressed her gratitude to everyone who had supported her throughout her career as a voice actress and singer. She also stated that she would continue to approach her works and roles with sincerity and strive to grow further as a performer.

"Although I still have much to learn, I hope to continue growing as an individual as well, taking things one step at a time each day. I would be grateful if you would continue to watch over me warmly," she wrote.

Yasuno was born in Kyoto Prefecture on July 9, 1989. She moved to Miyagi Prefecture shortly after her birth. She grew up in Wakuya, from the age of three to 11 before moving to Tokyo during her sixth year of elementary school. At the age of nine, she became interested in voice acting after watching a special program about Kaitou Saint Tail , which featured behind the scenes footage of anime voice recording sessions.

At the age of 15, Yasuno entered the Voice Actor Talent Course at Avex Artist Academy as a scholarship student. She made her leading role debut in 2011 as Kizuna Todoroki in the theatrical anime Kizuna Ichigeki .

Yasuno is best known for her roles as Katou Megumi in Saenai Heroine no Sodatekata , Charmy Pappitson in Black Clover , Nejire Hadou in Boku no Hero Academia 3rd Season , Renner in Overlord II , Kaname Buccaneer in Macross Δ , and Botan Kumegawa in Anne Happy♪ .

Yasuno also has been active as a singer in music units like Walküre and The iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls. She made her solo singing debut in July 2017 with the mini-album Namida. under flying DOG . In November 2021, she formed music duo Poka Poka Ion with fellow voice actress Nao Touyama , which performed the opening theme for the Slow Loop television anime.

In March 2021, Yasuno received the Singing Award at the 15th Seiyuu Awards as a member of Walküre.

Official profile site: https://avex-pictures.co.jp/lineup/13332/ Official instagram: @ kiyonon_at_home Official YouTube: @ yasunokiyono.official

title: Light Novel 'Sono Mono. Nochi ni…' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content:
An official website opened for a television anime adaptation of NAHAaTO 's Sono Mono. Nochi ni... ( That Person. Later on... ) light novel on Sunday, revealing the main cast, staff, opening theme song artist, and a teaser visual (pictured). The anime will premiere in 2027.

Voice actors Kent Itou ( Isekai no Sata wa Shachiku Shidai ) and Yui Ogura ( Goblin Slayer ) are starring in the anime as Wazu and Mear, respectively.

Staff Chief Director: Kouichi Oohata ( 9: Ruler's Crown director) Director: Seung-deok Kim ( Kizoku Tensei assistant director) Series Composition: Kouichi Oohata , Hisashi Morimiya ( Himekishi wa Barbaroi no Yome ) Character Design: Kouichi Oohata , Yeon-su Choi Music Production: Pony Canyon Studio: Jumondou

Voice actor Kent Itou will perform the anime's opening theme song.

NAHAaTO originally penned the adventure fantasy novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website from September 2015 to August 2016. Earth Star Entertainment began publishing the light novel under its Earth Star Novel imprint in August 2016, featuring illustrations by Kazutomo Miya . The 12th and final volume was released in April 2019.

Urasuke Ayano drew the first manga adaptation in Comic Earth☆Star from March to August 2017, before getting discontinued. Earth Star Entertainment published the first volume in October 2017.

A second manga adaptation by Shinichirou Nariie ( Food Court de, Mata Ashita. ) began serialization in the same magazine in August 2018. Earth Star Entertainment published the sixth volume in November 2022.

Titan Comics licensed the second manga adaptation in English. The second volume was released on 27 October, with the third volume scheduled for a January 2027 release.
